static int counter = 0;
extern const volatile int reg;
typedef struct node node_t;
int main(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        if (i % 2) continue; else break;
    }
    switch (counter) {
    case 1: goto done;
    default: break;
    }
    do { counter--; } while (counter > 0);
done:
    return sizeof(node_t) + _Alignof(int);
}
_Static_assert(sizeof(int) == 4, "int");
register auto restrict inline _Thread_local _Noreturn
